newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SINGAPORE MANUFACTURING OUTPUT GROWS 3.2 PCT Q297.
newsitem.headline: SINGAPORE MANUFACTURING OUTPUT GROWS 3.2 PCT Q297.

text.p: Singapore said on Tuesday its manufacturing output grew by 3.2 percent year on year in the second quarter of 1997 after three consecutive quarters of decline.
The Ministry of Trade and Industry said in its quarterly economic report that manufacturing output fell by 5.5 percent year-on-year in the first quarter.
Singapore's financial and business services sector grew by 10.6 percent in the April-June period from the year before, against 10.7 percent in the first quarter.
